decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning from the date of the decision notice ref: 22/04264/FUL dated 12/05/2023Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & CompulsoryPurchase Act 2004.

The development shall be commenced and managed in strict accordance with the submitted Construction Management Plan (DX03-EN-S1-108 Rev A) and no deviation from the plan unless written authority has been provided from the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To ensure construction does not lead to damage of the nearby public road network and to minimise disruption to the neighbouring properties.

The development hereby approved shall be constructed in accordance with the materials and details approved under the discharge of Condition 3 of the planning permission granted under ref:20/02422/FUL and discharged under ref 21/02337/CND dated 03 September 2021.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory external appearance in the interest of visual amenity.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, subject to minor modifications as required in the conditions below, as set out in the attached schedule which forms part of this notice.Proposed Site Plan,20210212-PL01 R00 (Existing Floor Plans),20210212-PL02 R00 (Existing Front and Rear Elevations),20210212-PL03 R00 (Existing Side 1 and 2 Elevations),20210212-PL04 R00 (Existing Block Plan),20210212-PL5 R01 (Existing Block Plan),20210212-PL02 R00 (Proposed First Floor Plan),20210212-PL03 R00 (Proposed Second Floor Plan),20210212-PL04 R00 (Proposed Roof Plan),20210212-PL05 R00 (Proposed Elevations - Dated 03/05/2023)20210212-PL06 R00 (Proposed Section A-A and Section B-B),20210212-PL07 R00 (Existing and Proposed Street View),20250725-PL103 Revision R01 (Condition 13 Proposed Landscape Plan),SuDS Pro Forma.Supporting documents approved under 20/02422/FUL, 21/02337/CND, 25/02541/CND, 25/04273/CND:25/02541/CND:Screening Photographs x7 (Dated 21/07/2025)25/04273/CND:20250725-PL102 R01 (Condition 8 Proposed Storage of Bicycles),20250725-PL102A (Condition 10 Refuse Storage Facilities).21/02337/CND:20210212-PL02 R00 Construction Management Plan,Construction Logistics Plan by Studio 47 Architects.20/02422/FUL:Air quality assessment (Prepared by Isopleth Ref 01.0194002 AQ V1),Risk of Flood extent (LiDAR Spot Levels),Noise impact assessment (Prepared by Nova acoustics Ref 4793AL Version 1),External Daylight Study (Prepared by Base energy),Internal Average Sunlight Daylight Study (Prepared by Base Energy),Tree Survey and report (Ref 10406 Prepared by Crown Tree consultancy),Tree SpecificationsEnergy Statement (Prepared by Base Energy),CMP (Ref DX03-EN-S1-108 Rev A).Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The development hereby approved shall be undertaken and constructed in strict accordance with the Construction Logistics Plan approved under the discharge of Condition 5 of the planning permission granted under ref: 20/02422/FUL, discharged under ref 21/02337/CND dated 03 September 2021. Reason: To ensure considerate construction and to protect the amenities of the nearby residents to ensure that disruption is kept to a minimum and does not affect highway traffic flows.

Prior to occupation details of the siting and design of plugs, of electric vehicular charging points to be provided in accordance with London Plan standards (minimum 20% of spaces to be provided with electric charging points and a further 20% passive provision for electric vehicles in the future) shall be provided to the Local Planning Authority for approval in writing. All electric charging points shall be installed in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation of the development and permanently maintained and retained.Reason: To ensure that the development complies with the sustainable development policy requirements of the London Plan.

Cycle storage shall be provided in strict accordance with the details approved under the discharge of Condition 8 of the planning permission granted under ref: 22/04264/FUL, discharged under ref 25/04273/CND dated 09 February 2026. The approved cycle parking shall be provided on site prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, and shall be retained thereafter unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To provide secure cycle storage facilities free from obstruction in the interest of promoting sustainable travel.

All Non-Road Mobile Machinery (NRMM) of net power of 37kW and up to and including 560kW used during the course of the demolition, site preparation and construction phases shall comply with the emission standards set out in chapter 7 of the GLA's supplementary planning guidance "Control of Dust and Emissions During Construction and Demolition" dated July 2014 (SPG), or subsequent guidance. Unless it complies with the standards set out in the SPG, no NRMM shall be on site, at any time, whether in use or not, without the prior written consent of the local planning authority. The developer shall keep an up to date list of all NRMM used during the demolition, site preparation and construction phases of the development on the online register at https://nrmm.london/Reasons: In the interests of good air quality with regard to London Plan policies.

The parking spaces shown on the approved plan (Ref 20250725-PL103 R01) shall be provided and maintained thereafter in perpetuity for the parking of motor vehicles solely for the benefit of the occupants of the new dwellings hereby approved and for no other purpose whatsoever.Reason: To ensure that the development complies with Development Plan Policies, does not lead to conditions prejudicial to the free flow and safety of users of adjoining highways and to prevent the introduction of activity which would be detrimental to amenity

Refuse storage shall be provided in strict accordance with the details approved under the discharge of Condition 10 of the planning permission granted under ref: 22/04264/FUL, discharged under ref 25/04273/CND dated 09 February 2026. The approved refuse storage shall be provided on site prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, and shall be retained thereafter unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: In the interests of amenity and the recycling of waste materials in support of the Boroughs waste reduction target.

Prior to first occupation of the development hereby permitted, details of a Sustainable Drainage Strategy shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include:-Demonstration on how the SuDS Strategy has been designed to a 1 in 1 and 1 in 100 year storm event with the allowance for climate change-Further information on how the SuDS Strategy follows the London Plan Drainage Hierarchy and the principles of a SuDS Management Train-A detailed SuDS drawing including invert levels and flow directions-Final sizes, storage volumes, cross-sections, long-sections (where appropriate) and specifications of all the source control SuDS measures including rain gardens, infiltration basins, green roofs, swales and permeable paving. Include calculations demonstrating functionality where relevant-A detailed Management Plan for Future MaintenanceReason: To ensure the sustainable management of water, minimise flood risk, minimise discharge of surface water outside of the curtilage of the property and ensure that the drainage system will remain functional throughout the lifetime of the development.

The development hereby approved shall be constructed in accordance with the boundary details approved under the discharge of Condition 12 of the planning permission granted under ref: 20/02422/FUL and discharged under ref 21/02337/CND dated 3 September 2021. The boundary details to be implemented prior to first occupationReason: To ensure a satisfactory external appearance in the interest of visual amenity.

Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved drawings, the development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until details of hard and soft landscape works for the whole site have been submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Soft landscaping plans shall include planting plans (at a scale not less than 1:100), schedule of plants, noting species, plant sizes, plant containers (all at time of plating) and proposed numbers/densities and a landscape implementation programme. Hard landscaping works shall include: material details, if permeable materials are used full construction details (including cross sections) of permeable paving and their maintenance plan. All landscaping in accordance with the approved scheme shall be completed/planted during the first planting season following practical completion of the development hereby approved.  The landscaping details shall set out a plan for the continued management and maintenance of the site and any planting which dies, becomes severely damaged or diseased within five years of completion of the development shall be replaced with new planting in accordance with the approved details or an approved alternative and to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.The development shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the details as so approved prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, and shall be maintained as such thereafter. Reason: To safeguard the appearance and character of the area, and to enhance the appearance of the development.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2020 or any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting or modifying that Order, no development under the following class AA of Part 20 shall take place without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority:a. Article 3 and Schedule 2, Part 20 Classes AA.Reason: In order to protect the amenities of the adjoining occupiers, to ensure adequate amenity space is retained for each of the dwellings in accordance with adopted Policy, and to maintain a satisfactory appearance to the development.

Prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved, evidence demonstrating the energy efficiency methods stipulated in the submitted energy report prepared by Base Energy have been implemented shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local planning authority demonstrating that energy savings on site have been undertaken and completed.Reason: In the interest of sustainable development and to ensure that the Local Planning Authority satisfy CO2 emission reduction targets in accordance with Policies of the London Plan (2021), Policy CP20 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), Policy DMD 51 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

The hereby approved development shall be approved in accordance with the submitted air quality assessment (prepared by Isopleth Ref 01.0194002 AQ V1) and the acoustic report prepared by Nova acoustics Ref 4793AL Version 1).Reason: In the interests of maintaining high quality sound insulation to ensure good levels of residential accommodation.

Prior to first occupation, the development shall achieve a Certificate of Compliance to the relevant Secure by Design Guide(s) or alternatively achieve Crime Prevention Standards submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority in conjunction with the Metropolitan Police. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and thereafter shall be fully retained and maintained as such for the lifetime of the development. The measure shall include but not limited to,- The security apparatus shall include security lighting at the rear entrance to the site and clearly illustrate the design, sitting and lux levels.- Anti-climb apparatus- Flank window elevation, make, model and security fittings- Final security gate appearance and design- Secure access fob and systemReason: In the interests of protecting the privacy and security of neighbouring occupiers and future occupiers.

A minimum of 10% of the residential units hereby permitted shall be built in accordance with Approved Document M 2015, M4 Category 3: Wheelchair user dwellings. M4(3)(2)(b) 'accessible' will apply to all units where a resident has been identified. All wheelchair user dwellings must provide sufficient footprint and drawings must demonstrate that they can achieve a fully accessible layout. Reason: To provide accessible residential units which can be adapted to residents' changing needs throughout their lifetime in accordance with the London Plan policies, policies of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010) and Policy DMD 8 (General Standards for new residential development) of the Enfield Development Management Plan Local Document (2014).

Prior to the first occupation of the hereby permitted units all designated side facing windows shall be fixed shut and non-openable as per the approved plans. The windows shall be permanently retained as such thereafter.Reason: To prevent overlooking and loss of privacy in the interests of the amenities of the adjoining properties.

Privacy screens shall be provided in strict accordance with the details approved under the discharge of Condition 21 of the planning permission granted under ref: 21/04267/FUL, discharged under ref 25/02541/CND dated 07 September 2025. The approved privacy screens shall be retained on site in perpetuity unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: In the interests of residential amenity.
